'''Herut''' was part of a four-man [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] task force sent to greet and/or kill the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. He was led by [[Wehutti]]. The other members of the task force were [[Moahdi]] and [[Kejas]]. Herut came to dislike Kenobi after the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attacked the task force in a misunderstanding that they were [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] enemies.
